note: Position corrections the combined build applies to agency stations (otc_pipeline.combine.apply_corrections). Each row applies only while the source still serves the published position; when the source changes it, the build stops so the row is reviewed. Found by A-NOAA (tide) and A-NOAAC (currents): the published position puts the station in the wrong country or ocean.

corrections.reason: Niue Island (N.Z.): NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; 169.92 E is in the sea west of Vanuatu, Niue is at 169.92 W
Neiafu, Vava'u, Tonga: NOAA gives 6.0167 E (in the Atlantic), which is 180 - 173.9833; Neiafu is at 173 deg 59 min W
Nomuka, Tonga: NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; 174.79 E is near Fiji, Nomuka is at 174.79 W
San Lorenzo, Ecuador: NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; 78.83 E is in the Indian Ocean, San Lorenzo is at 78.83 W
Savannah River Approach, Georgia: NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; 80.85 E is in Tibet, the station is at 80.85 W off the Savannah River entrance
Cockspur Island, NE of, Georgia: NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; the station is at 80.87 W in the Savannah River entrance
Butter Bean Beach, Skidaway River, Georgia: NOAA's longitude has the wrong sign; the station is at 81.07 W south of Savannah
